name: emailit-fanout
description: Cloudflare Worker that fans one Emailit webhook out to many destinations with filters

EMAILIT_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Signing secret of your Emailit webhook (whsec_...). Leave empty for now and set it after you create the webhook in Emailit.

DESTINATIONS.description: JSON array of destinations, see the README. Start with [{"name":"test","url":"https://example.com/hook"}].

scripts.deploy: wrangler queues create emailit-fanout-dead || true; wrangler deploy
